## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Regenerating after a design change

New captures from the design go into `public/contoh/home-new.html`. Then:

```bash
python3 scripts/regen-home.py
```

That rebuilds `app/_content/home.html`, keeping the design byte-for-byte except
for the three things it must change (asset paths, the missing error state, and
the submit handler described below). It refuses to write if a referenced asset
is missing, if the success message moved, if the submit handler is no longer
recognisable, or if it would emit a malformed closing tag -- each of which has
bitten this page before.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

Three things silently break this, all of which we hit:

1. **Pasting the script inside `function myFunction() { ... }`.** Apps Script
   only serves a web app through a *global* `doPost`; nested one level down it
   is invisible and every request returns a Google error page. Paste at the top
   level and delete the `myFunction` stub.
2. **Not deploying a new version.** The `/exec` URL is pinned to a version.
   After any edit: Deploy -> Manage deployments -> pencil -> Version: **New
   version** -> Deploy. Saving alone changes nothing.
3. **A standalone script instead of a Sheet-bound one.**
   `SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()` returns null outside a bound script,
   so set `SPREADSHEET_ID` in the script if you created it from
   script.google.com rather than from the Sheet's Extensions menu.

To verify, open the `/exec` URL in a browser -- the script answers `doGet` with
`{"ok":true,...}`. A login page or "Access Denied" means access is not set to
"Anyone" (note: *"Anyone with Google Account" is not enough*).

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Repairing the Sheet after a script upgrade.** `sheet_()` only writes headers
into an empty sheet, so a sheet that already has rows keeps whatever header row
it started with -- which goes stale when the form's fields change. Run
`repairSheet()` once from the Apps Script editor: it classifies each existing
row by which column actually holds Founder/Investor, remaps old-layout rows into
the current column order, and rewrites the header. Rows are rebuilt in memory
and written once, so an error cannot leave the sheet half-migrated.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

v## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

d## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |

| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on

A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

.## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

u## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |

| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

m## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which

form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

p## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

e## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

h## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

n## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.
