Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

i## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |

| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

i## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and

x## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

v## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

0## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

n## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.

   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join the Network"), Netlify form name **`network-signup`**.
A Founder/Investor toggle swaps which half of the form is shown:

| Role | Fields collected |
| --- | --- |
| Founder | `name` `email` `company` `url` |
| Investor | `name` `email` `firm` `focus` |

Plus `role` and a hidden `source`, `form-name` and `bot-field` honeypot.

Two bugs in the design file's own submit script were fixed, both of which would
have lost submissions silently:

1. It posted to `/`. On Netlify's Next runtime that returns the prerendered
   page, so nothing reaches Netlify Forms. It now posts to `/__forms.html`.
2. Its `.catch()` showed the thank-you message too, so a failed submission
   looked successful. Failures now show an error with a fallback email address.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.
